_why_two_claims: AGREEMENT asks whether the engines compute the same thing; RECOVERY asks whether they compute the right thing. Neither implies the other.

truth.source: the fixture's data-generating process: the policy changes length of stay by -1.2 days

agreement.claim: both engines report the same DiD, clustered SE and naive comparators
agreement._note: Observed spread on the committed fixture: 0. harness/quasi_examples.test.py checks the TWFE coefficient equals the 2x2 DiD of group means to 1e-10 (exact for a balanced single-date panel), and that the adopters' before-after change and the after-period group difference each miss the effect by more than 1.

recovery.claim: the estimates are close to the fixture's

calibration.rule: about 1.3 times the measured 99th percentile miss, rounded up
calibration.limits: 40 hospitals, 8 quarters; the tolerance separates the effect from zero. Measured by harness/quasi_examples.test.py, running python.py on seeds 0 to 99.
